title: Zero-friction call + code tiles for first-run API experience
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Design and produce a compact set of visual assets that surface the minimal path from sign-up to a successful first API call. Deliverables include: a model-selection carousel optimized for mobile, a one-line request builder that can toggle between simple and advanced modes, and three short code tiles (Python, Node, curl) that copy to clipboard. Screens should be annotated for engineering handoff and include visual redlines and accessibility contrast checks.
